title: Portfolio domain models (Pydantic)
description: Position, Equity, Account Pydantic models in app/portfolio/models.py, matching the shapes documented in docs/architecture/API.md.

checklist.step: Define Position (id, ticker, quantity, avg_cost_basis, entry_date, current_price, unrealized_pnl_pct)
Define Equity (cash, positions_value, total) and Account (equity, positions)
Add unit tests validating serialization matches the docs/architecture/API.md JSON examples exactly

decisions.decision: Kept current_price and unrealized_pnl_pct as optional (float | None) on Position rather than requiring them, and added a dedicated test asserting they default to None.
decisions.rationale: docs/architecture/API.md's GET /api/portfolio example always populates both fields, but POST /api/portfolio/positions only accepts ticker/quantity/avg_cost_basis/entry_date (no price) and the response is documented as 'same shape as in GET /api/portfolio' without guaranteeing a price is already known at creation time. Requiring them non-optional would force a fabricated 0.0/None-as-magic-number value immediately after a manual add, before the next price fetch populates them; Optional matches the pre-existing model and is the least surprising choice given the endpoint contract.

decisions.decision: Verified the pre-existing Position/Equity/Account models field-by-field against the GET /api/portfolio JSON example in docs/architecture/API.md instead of trusting the already-checked checklist items, per the task instructions; found them correct (field names, types, and nesting all match) so made no code changes to app/portfolio/models.py.
decisions.rationale: The task explicitly called for re-verification, not blind trust of prior checkmarks. Confirmed via round-trip serialization tests (tests/unit/test_portfolio_models.py) that use the exact JSON dict copied from API.md as both the expected serialization output and a deserialization input, so any future field/type drift between the model and the documented contract fails the test rather than silently passing.
